# crosswork_survey_settings (Data Source)

This data source can read the customer satisfaction survey setting of the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_survey_settings" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the customer satisfaction survey
- `id` (String) The id of the object
